title: No-Ghosting Application Tracker

brief.one_line_thesis: An AI-powered job application tracker that predicts ghosting risks and proactively generates context-aware follow-ups to keep candidates top-of-mind.

primary_persona.name: Alex, the Active Job Seeker
primary_persona.context: Applying to 10+ tech roles a week, juggling multiple interview stages across different companies, and struggling to keep track of when to follow up without seeming desperate.
primary_persona.emotional_state: Anxious, fatigued by the 'black hole' of job applications, seeking control, clarity, and a reduction in cognitive load.

secondary_actors.involvement: The recipients of the AI-generated follow-ups; their response times, communication patterns, and email sentiments are analyzed by the system to predict behavior.

brief.demonstrated_moment: The 'Intervention' moment: The user logs in to see an application's health drop to 'High Ghosting Risk', reviews the AI's analysis of the recruiter's last ambiguous email, and uses the AI to draft and send a perfectly timed, value-add follow-up.
jobs_to_be_done: Help me track the status, timeline, and next steps of all my active job applications in one unified, intelligent view.
Alert me when an application is at risk of going cold based on time elapsed and communication patterns, so I don't miss the window to follow up.
Draft professional, context-aware follow-up messages based on my specific interview stage, previous correspondence, and the company's profile.
Analyze recruiter communications to decode corporate speak, giving me a realistic assessment of my standing and extracting hidden action items.
success_criteria: Feels differentiated from generic SaaS by acting as an active, opinionated agent rather than a passive Kanban board.
The 'Ghosting Risk' indicator feels credible, data-driven, and actionable, not just a simple timer.
AI-generated follow-ups require zero-to-minimal editing before sending, perfectly matching the user's tone and the specific context of the role.
The UI reduces candidate anxiety through clear next steps, empathetic design, and a sense of regained control.

ai_inference_points.trigger: System ingests a new recruiter email or notes significant time elapsed since last contact.
ai_inference_points.model_call: Claude chat / OpenAI chat (classification and analysis)
ai_inference_points.input: Timeline of interactions, last email text, company name, interview stage, and industry average response times.
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Transforms passive waiting into proactive awareness; cuts through candidate anxiety with objective analysis.

ai_inference_points.trigger: User clicks 'Draft Follow-up' on an at-risk application.
ai_inference_points.input: Job description, user's resume summary, last recruiter email, days elapsed, and user-selected strategy (e.g., 'The Gentle Nudge', 'The Value Add', 'The Timeline Check').
ai_inference_points.output_shape: UI renders 3 distinct, highly personalized email draft options in a side-by-side comparison view, with highlighted variables for easy tweaking.
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Eliminates the blank-page anxiety of writing follow-up emails and prevents candidates from sending overly aggressive or desperate messages.

ai_inference_points.trigger: User pastes or forwards a recruiter's response into the tracker.
ai_inference_points.output_shape: JSON with `true_intent` (e.g., 'delaying for headcount', 'genuine interest', 'soft rejection'), `next_action_date`, and `extracted_tasks` (e.g., 'Provide references'). UI updates the application timeline automatically.
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Saves time on manual data entry and provides an expert 'second opinion' on what the recruiter is actually saying.

hard_constraints.accessibility: WCAG AA minimum, high contrast for status/risk indicators, screen-reader friendly for AI drafts.
other: Must not feel like a spam bot; emphasis on thoughtful, high-quality, low-volume communication.
Privacy-first data handling implied for personal emails and career data.

open_questions: Does the app integrate directly with Gmail/Outlook via OAuth for seamless tracking, or does the user manually input/forward communications?
Are we tracking applications via a browser extension (scraping LinkedIn/Greenhouse) or relying on manual entry for the initial job creation?
How do we calibrate the 'Ghosting Risk' model without a massive proprietary dataset initially? (e.g., relying purely on LLM heuristics vs. hardcoded time rules).

screens.purpose: Provide a unified, intelligent overview of all active job applications, triaged by required attention rather than just status.
screens.persona_state: Overwhelmed but seeking control; wants to know exactly what needs attention today without digging through spreadsheets.
content_blocks: Summary metrics: 12 Active, 2 Need Attention, 1 Offer
Application List: Sorted by 'Action Needed' and 'Ghosting Risk'
High Risk Card: Stripe - Product Designer (Last contact: 9 days ago)

screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific application's timeline, showing the AI's analysis of the current situation and recruiter sentiment.
screens.persona_state: Anxious about the silence from the recruiter; needs objective reassurance and a clear next step.
content_blocks: Header: Stripe - Product Designer (Stage: Onsite Panel)
Health Widget: Ghosting Risk Score (88/100 - High), Status: At Risk
AI Sentiment Analysis: 'Recruiter Sarah mentioned finalizing headcount, but 9 days exceeds their historical 4-day SLA. Soft delay likely.'
Timeline: Chronological list of emails and interviews

screens.purpose: Allow the user to guide the AI's tone and angle before generating the follow-up email.
screens.persona_state: Relieved to have help, but wants to ensure the email doesn't sound desperate or robotic.
secondary_actions: Cancel and return to detail view
content_blocks: Context recap: Following up after 9 days post-onsite.
Strategy Options: 'The Gentle Nudge' (Polite check-in), 'The Value Add' (Share a relevant article/portfolio piece), 'The Timeline Check' (Directly ask about next steps)

screens.purpose: Present the AI-generated options side-by-side, allowing easy comparison, tweaking, and sending.
screens.persona_state: Empowered; shifting from 'blank page paralysis' to an editorial mindset.
screens.primary_action: Click 'Copy to Clipboard' or 'Send via Gmail' on the preferred draft
content_blocks: Draft 2 (Value Add): Mentions a recent Stripe product launch.
Highlighted variables in text (e.g., [Date of Interview], [Interviewer Name])

screens.purpose: Ingest new recruiter emails to update the timeline and extract hidden meaning/action items.
screens.persona_state: Curious and slightly defensive; wants to know what the recruiter *really* means by their vague update.
screens.primary_action: Paste email text and click 'Decode & Log'
content_blocks: Helper text: 'We'll extract the true intent, update your timeline, and flag any hidden tasks.'

behavior_per_state.default: Solid color based on score (Red for >75, Yellow for 40-74, Green for <40).
behavior_per_state.hover: Expands slightly, reveals tooltip: '9 days since last contact. Industry avg: 4 days.'
behavior_per_state.loading: Desaturated grey with a sweeping shimmer effect.
behavior_per_state.success: Pulses green once when a new positive communication is logged, then settles to new score.

behavior_per_state.default: White card, subtle border, text truncated with fade.
behavior_per_state.hover: Elevates (box-shadow increases), border turns primary brand color, 'Copy' button appears.
behavior_per_state.active: Border thickens, background tints slightly to indicate selection.
behavior_per_state.loading: Three skeleton text lines with a left-to-right gradient wave.

motion_contract.encodes: Urgency and health status. Shifts smoothly from green to red as days elapse, creating a visceral sense of decaying momentum.

motion_contract.element: Draft Strategy Modal to Comparison View
motion_contract.encodes: Expansion of possibilities. The single modal expands horizontally into three distinct columns, visually representing the AI generating multiple options.
The feeling of a bespoke, real-time thought process. Text fades in line-by-line rather than appearing instantly, reassuring the user that the AI is 'writing' specifically for them.
Context preservation. Slides in from the right over the detail view, ensuring the user doesn't feel they've lost their place in the application timeline.

ai_flows.fires_on_trigger: Screen load (if cache expired) or 'Run Health Check' click
ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an expert technical recruiter and career coach. Analyze the provided timeline and last communication to assess the likelihood the candidate is being ghosted.

ai_flows.renders_into: application_detail_view -> Health Widget & AI Sentiment Analysis block

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an executive communication coach. Write highly professional, concise, and context-aware follow-up emails for a job seeker. Never sound desperate. Provide 3 distinct variations based on the requested strategy.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Role: {{role_title}} at {{company_name}}. Last contact: {{days_since_contact}} days ago. Last recruiter email: '{{last_raw_text}}'. Strategy requested: {{selected_strategy}}. Generate 3 drafts.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an expert at decoding corporate HR speak. Read the raw recruiter email and extract the true intent, sentiment, and any hidden action items.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Extract data from this recruiter email: '{{pasted_email_text}}'

brand_application.voice_tone: ambitious, student-first, plain-spoken, evidence-driven, never bombastic, never marketing-puffy

critique.summary: The prototype successfully implements the core AI flows, state transitions, and overall layout specified in the brief. However, it introduces several rogue hex colors that violate the Design System, misses key micro-interactions (tooltips, hover states), and fails to fully implement the spatial extension motion contract for the draft comparison view.

issues.description: The CSS introduces several rogue hex codes not defined in the Design System (e.g., #F0F0F0, #737373, #FBE7EA, #FEFAFA, #E6F4EA, #888, #ccc, #fff).
issues.fix: Replace all rogue hex codes with exact tokens from the Design System or rgba() derivatives of those exact tokens (e.g., rgba(200, 16, 46, 0.1) instead of #FBE7EA).

issues.description: The Ghosting Risk Indicator is missing the specified hover micro-interaction (expands slightly, reveals tooltip).
issues.fix: Add CSS transform scale on hover and implement a custom tooltip element that fades in on hover.

issues.description: The AI Draft Card 'Copy' button is always visible, violating the spec which states it should only appear on hover.
issues.fix: Set the draft-actions container to opacity 0 by default, and opacity 1 on card hover or focus-within.

issues.description: The transition from Draft Strategy Modal to Comparison View does not honor the 'spatial_extension' motion contract (expanding horizontally).
issues.source_of_truth: Interaction Spec (motion_contract -> Draft Strategy Modal to Comparison View)
issues.fix: Wrap the drafts grid in a motion.div that animates its width from 33% (modal width) to 100% to simulate the horizontal expansion.

issues.description: Icon-only buttons (Close, Refresh) lack aria-labels, making them inaccessible to screen readers.
issues.fix: Add descriptive aria-label attributes to all icon-only buttons.
